meta.title: VCACE | Australia–Vietnam Cultural Experiences & Exchange
meta.description: VCACE connects Australia and Vietnam through culture—bringing people together through experiences, dialogue, creative learning and bilateral exchange.

hero.headline: Connecting cultures.
hero.subheadline: Bringing Australia and Vietnam together through culture.
hero.intro: VCACE is an emerging Australia-based bilateral cultural initiative connecting people, ideas and institutions through cultural experiences, dialogue, education and exchange.

vision.headline: Culture connects people, and creates new possibilities.
paragraphs: We envision a stronger Australia–Vietnam relationship enriched by shared cultural understanding, creative collaboration and lasting people-to-people connections. VCACE works across contemporary arts, music, film, performing arts, food, heritage, cultural education and living traditions.

Through partnerships, we create spaces to experience culture, exchange perspectives and develop work that crosses borders. We bring together artists, educators, communities and institutions to curate public experiences, facilitate dialogue, develop learning opportunities and connect collaborators across both countries.

values.title: Mutual understanding
values.text: We make room for Australian and Vietnamese perspectives and genuine two-way learning.

values.title: Collaboration
values.text: We create with practitioners and partners, not simply for audiences.

values.title: Contemporary relevance
values.text: We connect living traditions with today’s ideas, identities and creative practices.

values.title: Inclusion
values.text: We welcome diverse communities and make culture accessible across generations.

values.title: Integrity
values.text: We communicate clearly about our work, partnerships and impact.

programs.headline: Programs
programs.intro: Explore shared culture through four complementary pathways.

items.title: Cultural Experiences
items.text: Immersive experiences that bring culture to life.
items.examples: Exhibitions, music, dance, film, food, craft, movement and heritage encounters.

items.title: Cultural Dialogues
items.text: Conversations that deepen understanding between Australia and Vietnam.
items.examples: Public talks, artist conversations, panels, and dialogue with academics and cultural institutions.

items.title: Cultural Exchange
items.text: Connecting people and organisations across borders to create and learn together.
items.examples: Visiting practitioners, residencies, collaborative productions, studio visits, study and professional exchange.

items.title: Cultural Education
items.text: Sharing knowledge, skills and perspectives through creative learning.
items.examples: Workshops, masterclasses, cultural literacy, school programs, digital stories and research-informed resources.

collaborate.headline: Cultural exchange is built together.
paragraphs: VCACE welcomes conversations with artists, educators, curators, institutions, community organisations and supporters interested in meaningful Australia–Vietnam collaboration.
You might co-create a program, host an experience, contribute expertise, facilitate an exchange or support an emerging project.
